TRAVEL ESSENTIALS · TRAVEL GUIDE

Money in Vietnam: cash, cards and everyday payments

Simple payment habits that make markets, cafés, restaurants and local transport easier to navigate.

7
Seven Travel Editorial TeamOctober 5, 2026 · 4 min read
THE JOURNAL

A better way to see Vietnam.

Explore at your pace with thoughtful local guidance.

Plan with confidence ↗
← More in Travel Essentials

Vietnam uses the Vietnamese dong (VND). A mix of cards and a sensible amount of local cash is usually the easiest approach for visitors.

Keep some small notes handy

Cash remains useful for small purchases and local shops. Look carefully at note denominations, which can be easy to mix up when you first arrive.

Use cards where practical

Hotels and established businesses often accept cards, though acceptance and fees vary. Check the payment method before using a service and review your bank’s international transaction charges.

Currency exchange and ATM basics

Use reputable providers, check the displayed exchange rate and fees, and keep receipts for larger exchanges. Avoid carrying more cash than you need for the day.
